## 2021 Annual GMS and Extraordinary GMS

In 2021, the Company did not hold the Annual General Meeting of Shareholders and Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders under the mechanism applicable to publicly listed companies as the Company conducted its initial public offering on the Indonesia Stock Exchange on September 8, 2021. The decisions made by the Company's Shareholders refer to the provisions on decision making in accordance with Law No. 40/2007 on Limited Liability Companies and the Company's Articles of Association.

In 2021, the Company's Shareholders made several decisions without  holding  a  General  Meeting  of  Shareholders,  all  of which had been fully realized as stated in, among others, the following deeds:

1. Deed of Decision of Shareholders of PT Kedoya Adyaraya Tbk  No.  81  dated  May  20,  2021  drawn  up  before  Jose Dima Satria, SH, MKn, Notary in South Jakarta;

2. Akta Pernyataan Keputusan Pemegang Saham Perubahan Anggaran Dasar PT Kedoya Adyaraya Tbk No. 68 tanggal 4 Juni 2021 dibuat dihadapan Jose Dima Satria, SH, MKn, Notaris di Jakarta Selatan;
3. Akta Pernyataan Keputusan Pemegang Saham PT Kedoya Adyaraya  Tbk  No.  120  tanggal  14  Juni  2021  dibuat dihadapan Jose Dima Satria, SH, MKn, Notaris di Jakarta Selatan; dan
4. Akta Pernyataan Keputusan Pemegang Saham Perubahan Anggaran Dasar PT Kedoya Adyaraya Tbk No. 69 tanggal 14 Oktober 2021 dibuat dihadapan Jose Dima Satria, SH, MKn, Notaris di Jakarta Selatan.

## Dewan Komisaris

## Board of Commissioners

Dewan Komisaris merupakan organ Perseroan yang bertugas melakukan  pengawasan  secara  umum  dan  khusus  sesuai Anggaran  Dasar,  serta  memberikan  nasihat  dan  masukan kepada Direksi. Selain itu, Dewan Komisaris juga bertanggung jawab untuk memantau dan memastikan bahwa prinsip-prinsip GCG diterapkan secara konsisten dan berkelanjutan.

## Pedoman Dewan Komisaris

Perseroan telah memiliki Pedoman Dewan Komisaris untuk mendukung dan memudahkan Dewan Komisaris dalam  memahami  dan  melaksanakan  tugas  dan  tanggung jawab, serta wewenangnya secara efektif, efisien, serta dapat  dipertanggungjawabkan.  Pedoman  tersebut  disusun berdasarkan Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan No. 33/ POJK.04/2014 dan Anggaran Dasar Perseroan.

## Komposisi Dewan Komisaris

Dewan  Komisaris Perseroan terdiri dari 2  orang  Dewan Komisaris (termasuk Komisaris Utama) dan 2 orang Komisaris Independen yang diangkat oleh RUPS untuk jangka waktu 5 tahun serta dapat diangkat kembali untuk periode berikutnya. Pada tanggal 10 Januari 2022, Perseroan melakukan perubahan komposisi Dewan  Komisaris berdasarkan hasil keputusan RUPS Luar Biasa pada tanggal 10 Januari 2022. Berdasarkan hasil  keputusan  RUPS  Luar  Biasa  tersebut,  komposisi  Dewan Komisaris Perseroan saat ini berjumlah 4 orang dari sebelumnya 3 orang. Berikut komposisi Dewan Komisaris Perseroan:

2. Deed  of  Shareholders'  Decision  on  Amendment  to  PT Kedoya  Adyaraya  Tbk's  Articles  of  Association  No.  68 dated June 4, 2021 drawn up before Jose Dima Satria, SH, MKn, Notary in South Jakarta;
3. Deed of Decision of Shareholders of PT Kedoya Adyaraya Tbk No. 120 dated June 14, 2021 drawn up before Jose Dima Satria, SH, MKn, Notary in South Jakarta; and
4. Deed  of  Shareholders'  Decision  on  Amendment  to  PT Kedoya  Adyaraya  Tbk's  Articles  of  Association  No.  69 dated October 14, 2021 drawn up before Jose Dima Satria, SH, MKn, Notary in South Jakarta.

The Board of Commissioners is a corporate body whose duties are to carry out general and special supervision in accordance with the Articles of Association, as well as to provide advices and recommendations to the Board of Directors. In addition, the Board of Commissioners is responsible for monitoring and ensuring that the GCG principles are applied in a consistent and continuous manner.

## Board of Commissioners' Charter

The  Company  has  prepared  the  Board  of  Commissioners' Charter to support and facilitate the Board of Commissioners in understanding and carrying out their duties and responsibilities,  as  well  as  to  exercise  their  authorities  in  an effective, efficient, and accountable manner. The Charter was prepared in accordance with Financial Services Authority No. 33/POJK.04/2014 and the Company's Articles of Association.

## Board of Commissioners' Composition

The  Board  of  Commissioners  consists  of  2  Commissioners, one of whom is President Commissioner, and 2 Independent Commissioners appointed by the GMS for a period of 5 years and can be reappointed for the next period. On January 10, 2022, the composition of the Board of Commissioners changed in  accordance  with  the  resolutions  of  the  Extraordinary  GMS on January 10, 2022. As a result, the Board of Commissioners currently consists of 4 members, went up from 3 in the previous composition. The composition of the Board of Commissioners is as follows:

## Komisaris Independen

Perseroan memiliki Komisaris Independen agar dapat menjalankan  segala  tindakan  pengurusan  Perseroan  dengan pihak  lain  secara  independen,  serta  bebas  dari  pengaruh yang  berhubungan  dengan  kepentingan  pribadi  atau  pihak lain.  Pada  tahun 2022, Perseroan memiliki 2 orang Komisaris Independen  dari  4  anggota  Dewan  Komisaris  Perseroan, yaitu Murniadi Chandra dan dr. Yanto Sandy Tjang yang telah menyatakan pernyataan independensi.

## Independent Commissioner

The Company has Independent Commissioners to ensure that all management actions involving other parties are carried out independently  and  free  from  influence  related  to  personal interests or other parties. In 2022, the Board of Commissioners had 4 members, 2 of whom were Independent Commissioners namely Murniadi Chandra and dr. Yanto Sandy Tjang who had declared their independency.

Selain  memenuhi  kriteria  independensi  tersebut,  Komisaris Independen  Perseroan  juga  harus  memenuhi  persyaratan sebagai berikut:

1. Mempunyai akhlak, moral, dan integritas yang baik;
2. Cakap melakukan perbuatan hukum;
3. Dalam 5 tahun sebelum pengangkatan dan selama menjabat:
- a. Tidak pernah dinyatakan pailit;
- b. Tidak pernah menjadi anggota Dewan  Komisaris dan/atau  anggota  Direksi  yang  dinyatakan  bersalah menyebabkan suatu perusahaan dinyatakan pailit;
- c. Tidak pernah dihukum karena melakukan tindak pidana yang merugikan keuangan  negara  dan/atau yang berkaitan dengan sektor keuangan;
7. d Tidak pernah menjadi anggota Dewan Komisaris dan/ atau anggota Direksi yang selama menjabat:
- Pernah tidak menyelenggarakan RUPS Tahunan;
- Pertanggungjawabannya sebagai anggota Dewan Komisaris dan/atau anggota Direksi pernah  tidak  diterima  oleh  RUPS  atau  pernah tidak memberikan pertanggungjawaban sebagai anggota  Dewan  Komisaris  dan/atau  anggota Direksi kepada RUPS; dan
- Pernah menyebabkan perusahaan yang memperoleh izin, persetujuan, atau pendaftaran dari Otoritas Jasa Keuangan tidak memenuhi kewajiban menyampaikan Laporan Tahunan dan/atau Laporan Keuangan kepada Otoritas Jasa Keuangan;
4. Memiliki komitmen untuk mematuhi peraturan perundangundangan; dan
5. Memiliki  pengetahuan  dan/atau  keahlian  di  bidang  yang dibutuhkan perusahaan publik.

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab Dewan Komisaris

Berdasarkan Pedoman Dewan Komisaris, tugas dan tanggung jawab  Dewan  Komisaris  beserta  realisasinya  di  tahun  2022 dijelaskan sebagai berikut:

The Company's Independent Commissioners must also meet the following requirements:

1. Possess good characters, morals, and integrity;

2.

Able to carry out legal actions;

3. In the 5 years before and during office term:
- a. Have never been declared bankrupt;
- b. Have never been members of the Board of Commissioners and/or Board of Directors held responsible for the bankruptcy of a company;
- c. Have  never  been  convicted  for  criminal  offense  that inflict losses on the state finance and/or related to the financial sector;
- d. Never been a member of the Board of Commissioners and/or a member of the Board of Directors who during their tenure:
- Failed to hold an Annual GMS;
- Failed  to  receive  approval  from  GMS  with  regard to  their  accountability  as  a  member  of  the  Board of  Commissioners  and/or  a  member  of  the  Board of Directors or failed to provide accountability as a member of the Board of Commissioners and/or a members of the Board of Directors to the GMS; and
- Had caused a company that has obtained a permit, approval or registration from the Financial Services Authority to fail to fulfill its obligation to submit an Annual Report and/or Financial Statements to the Financial Services Authority;
4. Possess commitment to complying with laws and regulations; and
5. Possess the necessary knowledge and/or skills in the fields relevant to publicly listed companies.

## Rapat Dewan Komisaris

Kebijakan Rapat

Pelaksanaan rapat internal Dewan  Komisaris berdasarkan Pedoman  Dewan  Komisaris  diselenggarakan  minimal  1  kali dalam  2 bulan. Sementara  itu,  rapat  gabungan  dengan Direksi  diselenggarakan  minimal  1  kali  dalam  4  bulan,  serta menghadiri setiap diadakannya RUPS Tahunan maupun RUPS lainnya. Kehadiran Dewan Komisaris dalam rapat selama tahun 2022 ditunjukkan pada tabel berikut:

## Realisasi Tahun 2022

2022 Realization

Memberikan  persetujuan  terhadap  beberapa  tugas  dan  wewenang Direksi dalam pelaksanaan koordinasi, penyelarasan, dan penyempurnaan sistem  dengan  PT  Sarana  Mediatama  Metropolitan  Tbk  selaku  Entitas Induk dari Perseroan yang mengelola Grup RS EMC Healthcare.

Approved the Board of Directors' duties and authorities in coordinating, aligning, and improving the system with PT Sarana Mediatama Metropolitan Tbk as the Parent Entity of the Company that manages the EMC Healthcare Hospital Group.

## Direksi

## Board of Directors

Direksi  merupakan  organ  Perseroan  yang  berwenang  dan bertanggung jawab penuh atas pengurusan Perseroan. Masingmasing anggota Direksi bekerja sesuai pembagian tugas yang telah diatur dalam kebijakan Perseroan.

## Pedoman Direksi

Perseroan telah memiliki Pedoman  Direksi yang disusun berdasarkan Peraturan Otoritas Jasa Keuangan No. 33/ POJK.04/2014  tentang  Direksi  dan  Dewan  Komisaris  Emiten atau  Perusahaan  Publik  serta  Anggaran  Dasar  Perseroan. Pedoman Kerja  Direksi  ini  dijadikan  dasar  dalam  memahami peraturan-peraturan terkait tata kerja Direksi.

## Komposisi Direksi

Direksi  Perseroan  terdiri  dari  2  orang  atau  lebih  anggota Direksi, seorang di antaranya dapat diangkat sebagai Direktur Utama.  Direksi  Perseroan  diangkat  oleh  RUPS  untuk  jangka waktu 5 tahun terhitung sejak pengangkatannya dengan tidak mengurangi  hak  RUPS  untuk  memberhentikannya  sewaktuwaktu. Anggota Direksi yang masa jabatannya telah berakhir dapat  diangkat kembali. Pada  tanggal  10  Januari 2022, Perseroan melakukan perubahan komposisi Direksi berdasarkan hasil  keputusan  RUPS  Luar  Biasa  pada  tanggal  10  Januari 2022. Berdasarkan hasil keputusan RUPS Luar Biasa tersebut, komposisi  Direksi  Perseroan  saat  ini  berjumlah  4  orang  dari sebelumnya 2 orang. Berikut komposisi Direksi Perseroan:

## Komposisi Direksi tanggal 4 Juni 202110 Januari 2022

The Board of Directors is a corporate body that is authorized and  fully  responsible  for  the  management  of  the  Company. Each member of the Board of Directors works according to the division of tasks in accordance with the Company's policy.

## Board of Directors' Charter

The  Company  has  prepared  the  Board  of  Directors'  Charter in  accordance  with  Financial  Services  Authority  Regulation No.  33/POJK.04/2014  on  the  Board  of  Directors  and  Board of  Commissioners  of  Listed  or  Public  Company.  The  Board of  Directors'  Charter  stipulates  the  Board  of  Directors'  work procedures.

## Board of Directors' Composition

The Board of Directors consists of 2 or more members, one of whom can be appointed as President Director. The Board of Directors is appointed by GMS with a term of office of 5 years without prejudice to GMS' rights to terminate them at any given time. Members of the Board of Directors can be reappointed for the subsequent period. On January 10, 2022, the composition of  the  Board  of  Directors  changed  in  accordance  with  the resolutions of the Extraordinary GMS on January 10, 2022. As a result, the Board of Directors currently consists of 4 members, went up from 2 in the previous composition. The composition of the Board of Directors is as follows:

## Hasil Penilaian

Hasil  penilaian  kinerja  Dewan  Komisaris  selama  tahun  2022 berdasarkan kriteria yang sudah ditentukan telah menunjukkan hasil yang  baik dan  telah memenuhi  indikator penilaian yang  ditetapkan.  Dewan  Komisaris  telah  menjalankan  tugas pengawasan atas pengelolaan Perseroan yang dijalankan oleh Direksi.  Selain  itu,  Dewan  Komisaris  juga  telah  melakukan pengawasan  dan  secara  proaktif  memberikan  arahan-arahan kepada Direksi yang mencakup semua aspek bisnis, termasuk memberikan persetujuan atas tindakan-tindakan yang memerlukan persetujuan Dewan Komisaris.

## Assessment Result

Based on predetermined criteria, the Board of Commissioners' performance assessment in 2022 had shown good results and met the assessment indicators. In  addition,  the Board of Commissioners had also supervised and proactively provided directions  to  the  Board  of  Directors  with  regard  to all business aspects, including giving approval for actions that require the approval of the Board of Commissioners.

## Performance Assessment Policy, Procedure, and Implementation

The Board of Directors' performance assessment is carried out once a year through self-assessment to be evaluated by the Board of Commissioners and presented at the Annual General Meeting  of  Shareholders  by  referring  to  the  predetermined performance assessment criteria, as follows:

<!-- image -->

## Hasil Penilaian

Selama periode 2022, hasil penilaian terhadap kinerja Direksi Perseroan telah menunjukkan  hasil yang baik dan telah memenuhi kriteria  penilaian  yang  ditetapkan.  Hasil  penilaian tersebut akan dijadikan dasar bagi Direksi untuk meningkatkan kinerja  serta  menjadi  dasar  penentuan  besaran  remunerasi yang akan diperoleh.

## Penilaian Kinerja Komite di bawah Dewan Komisaris

## Kebijakan, Prosedur, dan Pelaksanaan Penilaian Kinerja

Dewan  Komisaris  secara  berkala  melakukan  penilaian  atas kinerja komite di bawah Dewan Komisaris yang telah membantu dalam  mengawasi  dan  memberikan  nasihat  atas  kegiatan Perseroan.  Hasil  penilaian  ini  menjadi  dasar  pertimbangan dalam pengangkatan kembali anggota komite.

## Assessment Result

The Board of Directors' performance assessment in 2022 had shown good results  and  met  the  predetermined  assessment indicators.  The  results  of  the  assessment  will  be  used  as  the basis for the Board of Directors to improve performance and to determine the amount of remuneration received.

## Performance Assessment of Committees Under Board of Commissioners

## Performance Assessment Policy, Procedure, and Implementation

The Board of Commissioners regularly evaluates the performance of its supporting committees that provide assistance in supervising and providing advice on the Company's  activities.  The  results  of  the  assessment  become the basis of consideration with regard to the reappointment of committee members.

## Kriteria

Kriteria  penilaian  terhadap  kinerja  komite  dilakukan  dengan mempertimbangkan  pemenuhan  tugas  dan  tanggung  jawab serta kualitas pendapat dan saran dari komite.

## Hasil Penilaian

Komite Audit telah melaksanakan tugas dan tanggung jawab dalam mengawasi  hal-hal yang terkait dengan  informasi keuangan, sistem pengendalian internal, serta efektivitas pemeriksaan  oleh  auditor  internal  dan  eksternal.  Dengan demikian, Dewan Komisaris menilai kinerja Komite Audit pada tahun 2022 telah efektif dan sesuai dengan Pedoman Komite Audit.

Sementara  itu,  pada  tahun  2022,  Komite  Nominasi  dan Remunerasi telah membantu Dewan Komisaris dalam memberi usulan  terkait  sistem  dan  kebijakan  remunerasi  yang  sesuai bagi  Dewan Komisaris  dan  Direksi.  Dewan  Komisaris  menilai sepanjang tahun 2022 Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi telah menjalankan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya dengan baik.

## Penilaian Kinerja Organ Pendukung Direksi

Pemenuhan tugas dan tanggung jawab Direksi terkait pelaksanaan GCG dibantu oleh Sekretaris Perusahaan dan Unit Audit Internal. Oleh karena itu, penilaian kinerja organ tersebut menjadi  salah  satu  agenda  yang  perlu  dilaksanakan  setiap tahun  oleh  Direksi.  Kriteria  penilaian  meliputi  pemenuhan tugas dan tanggung jawab, serta kualitas pekerjaan.

Berdasarkan  hasil  penilaian,  Sekretaris  Perusahaan  dan  Unit Audit Internal secara konsisten telah mendukung implementasi GCG, khususnya kepatuhan terhadap peraturan dan ketentuan. Di  sisi  lain,  kualitas  pelaksanaan  GCG  pada  Perseroan  juga dinilai  mengalami  peningkatan  jika  dibandingkan  dengan tahun sebelumnya, khususnya dalam hal peninjauan terhadap prosedur operasi standar (SOP) yang berlaku dan penyusunan SOP baru yang dibutuhkan.

## Informasi tentang Komite di bawah Direksi

Hingga akhir tahun 2022, Perseroan tidak membentuk komite di  bawah  Direksi,  sehingga  tidak  terdapat  informasi  terkait pelaksanaan  tugas  dan  penilaian  terhadap  kinerja  komite  di bawah Direksi. Meskipun demikian, pelaksanaan tugas Direksi dibantu oleh unit/departemen di bawah  Direksi  dengan penilaian kinerja unit/departemen di bawah Direksi dilakukan oleh seluruh Direksi.

## Criteria

Committees' performance assessment criteria are carried out by considering the fulfillment of duties and responsibilities as well as the quality of opinions and suggestions provided by the committees.

## Assessment Result

The Audit Committee had carried out its duties and responsibilities in supervising matters related to financial information,  internal  control  systems,  and  the  effectiveness of  audits  by  internal  and  external  auditors.  Therefore,  the Board of Commissioners concludes that the Audit Committee performed  effectively  in  2022  in  accordance  with  the  Audit Committee's Charter.

In 2022, the Nomination and Remuneration Committee had assisted the Board of Commissioners in providing recommendations regarding appropriate remuneration systems  and  policies  for  the  Board  of  Commissioners  and Board  of  Directors.  The  Board  of  Commissioners  concludes that  throughout  2022,  the  Nomination  and  Remuneration Committee had properly carried out its duties and responsibilities.

## Performance Assessment of Board of Directors' Supporting Bodies

In  performing  its  duties  and  responsibilities  with  regard  to GCG implementation, the Board of Directors is assisted by the Corporate Secretary and the Internal Audit Unit. The Board of Directors  therefore  assesses  their  performance  on  an  annual basis. The assessment criteria include the fulfillment of duties and responsibilities, as well as the quality of work.

Based on the results of the assessment, the Corporate Secretary and the Internal Audit Unit had consistently supported GCG implementation,  particularly  with  regard  to  compliance  with applicable  rules  and  regulations.  Likewise,  the  Company's GCG implementation quality had also increased compared to the previous year, particularly in terms of applicable standard operating procedures (SOPs) assessment as well as the preparation of the necessary new SOPs.

## Information on Committees Under Board of Directors

As  of  end  of  2022,  the  Company  had  yet  to  establish committees under the Board of Directors. Therefore, there is no information regarding the implementation of duties or the performance  assessment  of  committees  under  the  Board  of Directors. Nonetheless, in performing its duties, the Board of Directors is assisted by units/departments under the Board of Directors and their performance is evaluated by all members of the Board of Directors.

## Pengembangan Kompetensi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi

Board of Commissioners' and Board of Directors' Competency Development

## Kebijakan Pengembangan Kompetensi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi

Kebijakan mengenai program peningkatan kompetensi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi diuraikan sebagai berikut:

1. Program peningkatan kompetensi dilaksanakan guna meningkatkan efektivitas Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi;
2. Rencana  pelaksanaan  program  peningkatan  kompetensi diuraikan  dalam  Rencana  Kerja  dan  Anggaran  Dewan Komisaris dan Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran Direksi;
3. Anggota Dewan Komisaris yang mengikuti program peningkatan  kompetensi  berupa  seminar  dan  pelatihan harus menyajikan presentasi untuk anggota Dewan Komisaris  lain  guna  berbagi  informasi  dan  pengetahuan. Begitu pula dengan  anggota  Direksi yang  mengikuti program peningkatan kompetensi harus menyajikan presentasi untuk anggota Direksi lain; dan
4. Anggota Dewan Komisaris yang mengikuti pengembangan kompetensi  bertanggung  jawab  membuat  laporan  tentang pelaksanaan program peningkatan kompetensi untuk disampaikan kepada Dewan Komisaris. Sama halnya dengan  anggota  Dewan  Komisaris,  anggota  Direksi  yang mengikuti  pengembangan  kompetensi  bertanggung  jawab membuat laporan tentang pelaksanaan program peningkatan kompetensi untuk disampaikan kepada Direksi.

## Board of Commissioners' and Board of Directors' Competency Development Policy

The  Board  of  Commissioners'  and  the  Board  of  Directors' competency Development program policy is as follows:

1. Competency  development  program  is  implemented  to improve the effectiveness of the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors;
2. The competency development program implementation plan is described in the Board of Commissioners' Work Plan and Budget and the Board of Directors' Work Plan and Budget;
3. Members of the Board of Commissioners who participate in  competency  development  program  in  the  form  of seminars and training are required to share information and knowledge they acquired to other members of the Board of  Commissioners.  Likewise,  members  of  the  Board  of Directors who participate in the competency development program  are  required  to  share  their  knowledge  to  other members of the Board of Directors; and
4. Members of the Board of Commissioners who participate in  competency  development  program  are  required  to prepare  reports  on  the  implementation  of  competency development  program  to  be  submitted  to  the  Board of  Commissioners.  Likewise,  members  of  the  Board  of Directors  who  participate  in  competency  development program are required to prepare reports on the implementation of competency development program to be submitted to the Board of Directors.

## Nominasi dan Remunerasi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi

Board of Commissioners' and Board of Directors' Nomination and Remuneration

## Nominasi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi

## Prosedur Nominasi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi

Perseroan telah menyusun kebijakan mengenai nominasi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi yang bertujuan untuk menjaga  kesinambungan  proses  regenerasi  atau  kaderisasi kepemimpinan  di  Perseroan  dalam  rangka  mempertahankan keberlanjutan bisnis dan tujuan jangka panjang Perseroan.

Adapun  prosedur  nominasi  Dewan  Komisaris  dan  Direksi diuraikan sebagai berikut:

1. Pemegang  Saham  yang  mewakili  1/10  atau  lebih  dari jumlah  seluruh  saham  dapat  mengusulkan  nama-nama calon Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi;
2. Dewan Komisaris melakukan penelaahan dan memberikan rekomendasi untuk diajukan dalam RUPS Tahunan; dan
3. RUPS  memutuskan  pengangkatan  Dewan  Komisaris  dan Direksi.

## Program Orientasi bagi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi yang Baru Diangkat

## Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors Nomination

## Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors Nomination Procedure

The  Company  has  prepared  the  Board  of  Commissioners and  the  Board  of  Directors  nomination  policy  that  aims to  maintain  the  continuity  of  the  regeneration  process  or leadership regeneration in the Company in order to maintain the  Company's business sustainability and achieve long-term goals.

The nomination procedure for the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors is as follows:

1. Shareholders  representing  1/10  of  the  total  number  of shares or more may propose candidates for the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors;
2. The Board of Commissioners reviews and provides recommendations to be submitted at the Annual General Meeting of Shareholders; and
3. The  General  Meeting  of  Shareholders  decides  on  the appointment of the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors.

## Remunerasi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi

## Prosedur dan Dasar Penetapan Remunerasi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi

Prosedur  dan  dasar  penetapan  remunerasi  Dewan  Komisaris ditentukan oleh keputusan Pemegang  Saham  Perseroan. Sedangkan,  penetapan  remunerasi  Direksi  ditentukan  oleh keputusan  Pemegang  Saham  Perseroan  yang  dilimpahkan kepada  Dewan  Komisaris  Perseroan.  Hal  ini  dilakukan  demi menghindari  konflik  kepentingan,  dimana  Dewan  Komisaris dapat menentukan remunerasinya sendiri.

## Struktur dan Besaran Remunerasi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi

Berdasarkan peraturan yang berlaku, struktur remunerasi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi meliputi gaji pokok dan tunjangan yang bersifat tetap dan/atau tidak tetap. Pada tahun 2022, besaran remunerasi untuk Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi sebesar Rp8.967.061.739,-.

## Board of Commissioners' and Board of Directors' Remuneration

## Board of Commissioners' and Board of Directors' Remuneration Procedure and Amount

The  Board  of  Commissioners'  remuneration  procedure  and amount  are  determined  by  the  Shareholders.  The  Board of  Directors'  remuneration,  however,  is  determined  by  the Shareholders'  decision  that  is  delegated  to  the  Board  of Commissioners.  This  is  done  to  avoid  conflicts  of  interest wherein  the  Board  of  Commissioners  can  determine  its  own remuneration.

## The Board of Commissioners' and Board of Directors' Remuneration Amount and Structure

Pursuant to the applicable regulations, the Board of Commissioners'  and  the  Board  of  Directors'  remuneration structure  includes  a  fixed  and/or  variable  basic  salary  and allowances. In 2022, the total remuneration for Board of Commissioners  and  Board of Directors  amounted  to Rp8,967,061,739.

## Komite Audit

Audit Committee

Komite Audit bertanggung jawab untuk membantu pelaksanaan tugas dan fungsi Dewan Komisaris guna memastikan kebenaran  Laporan  Keuangan  Perseroan  yang  disusun  oleh Direksi,  mengawasi  kepatuhan  Perseroan  terhadap  peraturan perundangan  yang  berlaku,  serta  memastikan  independensi dan mengefektifkan fungsi dan program kerja audit baik oleh auditor eksternal maupun audit internal.

## Pedoman Komite Audit

Perseroan memiliki  Piagam  Komite  Audit  yang  disusun  pada tanggal  4  Juni  2021  yang  kemudian  diubah  dan  disahkan pada  tanggal  21  Maret  2022.  Piagam  tersebut  disusun  agar Komite Audit dapat melaksanakan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya secara efisien, efektif, transparan, independen, dapat dipertanggungjawabkan,  serta  dapat  diterima  oleh  semua pemangku kepentingan

## Komposisi Komite Audit

Komite  Audit  Perseroan  berjumlah  3  orang,  yang  terdiri dari  1  orang  Ketua  Komite  Audit  yang  seorang  Komisaris Independen dan 2 orang anggota Komite Audit dari pihak independen yang memiliki latar belakang pendidikan akuntansi dan keuangan.

## Profil Komite Audit

<!-- image -->

The Audit Committee is responsible for assisting the implementation  of  the  Board  of  Commissioners'  duties  and functions  to  ensure  the  accuracy  of  the  Company's  Financial Statements prepared by the Board of Directors, overseeing the Company's compliance with applicable laws and regulations, as well as ensuring independence and effectiveness of audit functions and work programs by both external auditors and internal audit.

## Audit Committee's Charter

The Company had prepared Audit Committee's Charter on June 4, 2021, which was subsequently revised and ratified on March 21, 2022. The Charter aims to ensure that the Audit Committee is able to carry out its duties and responsibilities in an efficient, effective, transparent, independent, and accountable manner with results that can be accepted by all stakeholders.

## Audit Committee's Composition

The Audit Committee consists of 3 members i.e. 1 Independent Commissioner as chairman and 2 independent members with accounting and financial education backgrounds.

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab Duties and Responsibilities

Melakukan penelaahan atas informasi keuangan yang akan dikeluarkan Perseroan  kepada  publik  dan/atau  pihak  otoritas,  antara  lain  Laporan Keuangan,  proyeksi dan  laporan lainnya terkait dengan  informasi keuangan Perseroan.

## Realisasi Tahun 2022

2022 Realization

Menelaah  Laporan  Keuangan  yang  dilakukan  secara  internal  serta melalui rapat dengan Unit Audit Internal dan audit eksternal yang telah dilaksanakan sebanyak 4  kali.

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab Duties and Responsibilities

Melakukan  penelaahan  atas  ketaatan  terhadap  peraturan  perundangundangan yang berhubungan dengan kegiatan Perseroan.

Reviewing compliance with laws and regulations relating to the Company's activities.

Memberikan pendapat independen dalam hal terjadi perbedaan pendapat antara manajemen dan akuntan atas jasa yang diberikan.

Providing independent opinion in the event of disagreements between management and accountant for the services rendered.

Memberikan rekomendasi kepada Dewan Komisaris mengenai penunjukkan akuntan yang didasarkan pada independensi, ruang lingkup penugasan, dan imbalan jasa.

Providing recommendations to the Board of Commissioners with regard to  appointment  of  an  accountant  based  on  independence,  scope  of assignment, and service fees.

Melakukan  penelaahan  atas  pelaksanaan  pemeriksaan  oleh  auditor internal  dan  mengawasi  pelaksanaan  tidak  lanjut  oleh  Direksi  atas temuan auditor internal.

Reviewing audits performed by the internal auditor and supervising the implementation of follow-ups by the Board of Directors on the findings of the internal auditors.

Reviewing risk management implementation activities carried out by the Board of Directors.

Menelaah  pengaduan  yang  berkaitan  dengan  proses  akuntansi  dan pelaporan keuangan Perseroan.

Reviewing complaints relating to the Company's accounting process and financial reporting.

Reviewing the public accountant's independence and Objectivity.

Reviewing the adequacy  of the audits performed  by  the public accountant.

Melakukan  pemeriksaan  terhadap  dugaan  adanya  kesalahan  dalam keputusan  rapat  Direksi  atau  penyimpangan  dalam  pelaksanaan  hasil keputusan rapat Direksi.

Investigating  allegations  of  errors  in  the  Board  of  Directors'  meeting resolutions  or  irregularities  in  the  implementation  of  the  Board  of Directors' meeting resolutions.

## Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi

Nomination and Remuneration Committee

Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi adalah komite yang dibentuk oleh dan bertanggung jawab kepada Dewan Komisaris dalam membantu melaksanakan fungsi dan tugas Dewan Komisaris terkait nominasi dan remunerasi terhadap anggota Direksi dan anggota Dewan Komisaris.

## Pedoman Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi

Komite  Nominasi  dan  Remunerasi  telah  memiliki  pedoman kerja  yang  ditetapkan  pada  tanggal  14  Maret  2022.  Piagam tersebut disusun agar Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi dapat melaksanakan  tugas  dan  tanggung  jawabnya  secara  efisien, efektif, independen, serta dapat dipertanggungjawabkan.

## Komposisi Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi

Komite  Nominasi  dan  Remunerasi  Perseroan  berjumlah  3 orang,  yang  terdiri  dari  1  orang  Ketua  Komite  Nominasi dan  Remunerasi  yang  seorang  Komisaris  Independen  dan  2 orang  anggota  Komite  Nominasi  dan  Remunerasi  dari  pihak independen.

The Nomination and Remuneration Committee is a committee formed  by  and  answers  to  the  Board  of  Commissioners, particularly to assist the Board of Commissioners in performing the  nomination  and  remuneration  functions  and  duties  for members of the Board of Directors and the Board

## Nomination and Remuneration Committee's Charter

The Company has prepared the Nomination and Remuneration Committee Charter on March 14, 2022. The Charter is intended to ensure that the Committee is able to carry out its duties and responsibilities  in  an  efficient,  effective,  independent,  and accountable manner.

## Nomination and Remuneration Committee's Composition

The  Nomination  and  Remuneration  Committee  consists  of  3 members i.e. 1 Independent Commissioner as chairman and 2 independent members.

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi

Berdasarkan Piagam Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi, tugas dan tanggung jawab Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi beserta realisasinya di tahun 2022 dijelaskan sebagai berikut:

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab

Duties and Responsibilities

## Fungsi Nominasi

Nomination Function

Memberikan rekomendasi kepada Dewan Komisaris mengenai:

1. Komposisi  jabatan  anggota  Dewan  Komisaris  dan/atau  anggota Direksi;
2. Kebijakan dan kriteria yang dibutuhkan dalam proses nominasi; dan
3. Kebijakan  evaluasi  kinerja  bagi  anggota  Dewan  Komisaris  dan/atau anggota Direksi.

Provide recommendations to the Board of Commissioners regarding the following matters:

1. Composition of the positions of members of the Board of Commissioners and/or members of the Board of Directors;
2. Policies and criteria required in the nomination process; and
3. Performance evaluation policy for members of the Board of Commissioners and/or members of the Board of Directors.

Membantu  Dewan  Komisaris  melakukan  penilaian  kinerja  anggota anggota Dewan Komisaris dan/atau anggota Direksi berdasarkan tolok ukur yang telah disusun sebagai bahan evaluasi.

Assist  the  Board  of  Commissioners  in  evaluating  the  performance  of members of the Board of Commissioners and/or members of the Board of Directors based on the predetermined benchmarks.

Memberikan rekomendasi kepada Dewan Komisaris mengenai program pengembangan kemampuan anggota Dewan Komisaris dan/atau anggota Direksi.

Provide recommendations to the Board of Commissioners regarding the capacity building program for members of the Board of Commissioners and/or members of the Board of Directors.

Memberikan  usulan  calon  yang  memenuhi  syarat  sebagai  anggota Dewan  Komisaris  dan/atau  anggota  Direksi  kepada  Dewan  Komisaris untuk disampaikan kepada RUPS.

Nominate candidates who meet the requirements to become members of the Board of Commissioners and/or members of the Board of Directors to  the  Board  of  Commissioners  to  be  presented  before  the  General Meeting of Shareholders.

## Fungsi Remunerasi

Remuneration Function

Memberikan rekomendasi kepada Dewan Komisaris mengenai:

1. Struktur remunerasi;
2. Kebijakan atas remunerasi; dan
3. Besaran remunerasi.

Provide  recommendations  to  the  Board  of  Commissioners  on  the following matters:

1. Remuneration structure;
2. Remuneration policy; and
3. Remuneration Amount.

Membantu Dewan Komisaris menilai kesesuaian kinerja dengan remunerasi yang diterima masing-masing anggota Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi.

Assist  the  Board  of  Commissioners  in  assessing  the  suitability  of performance  with  the  remuneration  received  by  each  member  of  the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors.

## Unit Audit Internal

## Internal Audit Unit

Unit  Audit  Internal  merupakan  organ  pendukung  Direksi  yang bertugas untuk mengevaluasi efektivitas penerapan sistem manajemen  risiko,  pengendalian  internal,  dan  GCG  di  seluruh unit kerja Perseroan. Hal tersebut dilakukan dengan memberikan pendapat independen yang dirancang dalam rangka menambah nilai dan meningkatkan kinerja operasi Perseroan.

## Pedoman Unit Audit Internal

Unit  Audit  Internal  Perseroan  telah  memiliki  Piagam  Unit Audit  Internal  yang  telah  disusun  pada  4  Juni  2021  yang kemudian diubah dan disahkan pada tanggal 21 Maret 2022. Piagam tersebut menjadi rujukan dalam memahami peraturanperaturan terkait tata kerja Unit Audit Internal.

The Internal Audit Unit is the Board of Directors' supporting body responsible for evaluating the implementation of the risk management system, internal control, and GCG at all of the Company's business units. To that end, the Internal Audit unit provides  independent  opinions  designed  to  add  value  and improve the Company's operating performance.

## Internal Audit Unit's Charter

The  Internal Audit Unit is equipped  with  Internal Audit Unit's  Charter  prepared  on  June  4,  2021,  and  subsequently amended and ratified on March 21, 2022. The Charter serves as a guideline in understanding the Internal Audit unit's work procedures.

## Struktur dan Kedudukan Unit Audit Internal

Struktur  dan  kedudukan  Unit  Audit  Internal  dalam  Perseroan sebagai berikut:

1. Unit  Audit  Internal  dipimpin  oleh  seorang  Kepala  Unit Audit Internal;
2. Kepala Unit Audit Internal diangkat dan diberhentikan oleh Direktur Utama atas persetujuan Dewan Komisaris;
3. Direktur Utama dapat memberhentikan Kepala Unit Audit Internal, setelah mendapat persetujuan Dewan Komisaris, jika Kepala Unit Audit Internal tidak memenuhi persyaratan sebagai Unit Audit Internal sebagaimana yang diatur dalam peraturan  perusahaan  dan/atau  gagal  atau  tidak  cakap menjalankan tugas;
4. Kepala  Unit  Audit  Internal  bertanggung  jawab  kepada Direktur Utama; dan
5. Auditor  yang  duduk  dalam  Internal  Audit  bertanggung jawab secara langsung kepada Kepala Unit Audit Internal.

Pada tahun 2022, Unit Audit Internal didukung oleh 1 personel.

## Internal Audit Unit's Structure and Position

The  Internal  Audit  Unit's  structure  and  position  within  the Company is as follows:

1. The Internal Audit Unit is led by the Head of the Internal Audit Unit;
2. The  Head  of  the  Internal  Audit  Unit  is  appointed  and dismissed by the President Director with the approval of the Board of Commissioners;
3. The  President  Director  may  dismiss  the  Head  of  the Internal Audit Unit, after obtaining approval from the Board of  Commissioners, if  the  Head  of  the  Internal  Audit  Unit failed to meet the requirements as an Internal Audit Unit as regulated in company regulations and/or failed or were incompetent in carrying out their duties;
4. The Head of the Internal Audit Unit answers to the President Director; and
5. Internal Audit Unit's auditors answer directly to the Head of the Internal Audit Unit.

In 2022, the Internal Audit Unit consisted of 1 member.

## Sistem Pengendalian Internal

## Internal Control System

Sistem  pengendalian  internal  Perseroan  meliputi  berbagai regulasi  pengendalian  yang  diterapkan  guna  memberikan keyakinan  yang  memadai  terhadap  pelaksanaan  operasional yang efektif  dan  efisien,  Laporan  Keuangan  yang  akurat  dan dapat  diandalkan,  serta  kepatuhan  terhadap  peraturan  yang berlaku untuk mencapai tujuan Perseroan. Implementasi sistem pengendalian  internal  Perseroan  tercermin  dari  pelaporan keuangan  dan  operasional  bisnis  Perseroan  yang  senantiasa dilaksanakan sesuai dengan peraturan yang berlaku.

Dalam hal menjalankan fungsinya sebagai penyedia pelayanan medis  kepada  masyarakat,  RS  Grha  Kedoya  memiliki  sistem pengendalian  internal  dari  sisi  profesionalisme,  khususnya profesionalisme  dokter  yang  dilakukan  oleh  Komite  Medis. Komite  Medis  adalah  perangkat  rumah  sakit  yang  bertugas untuk menerapkan tata kelola klinis ( clinical governance )  agar staf  medis  di  rumah  sakit  terjaga  profesionalismenya  melalui mekanisme  kredensial,  penjagaan  mutu  profesi  medis,  serta pemeliharaan etika dan disiplin profesi medis.

The Company's internal control system includes various control regulations  implemented  to  provide  adequate  assurance  of effective and efficient operations, accurate and reliable Financial Statements, as well as compliance with applicable regulations to achieve corporate objectives. The implementation of internal control system is reflected in the Company's financial reporting and business operations that are consistently carried out in accordance with applicable regulations.

In performing its function as a medical services provider, Grha Kedoya  Hospital  is  equipped  with  internal  control  system pertaining to professionalism, particularly the professionalism of doctors, implemented by the Medical Committee. The Medical Committee is a hospital body tasked with implementing clinical governance to maintain the professionalism of medical staff at the hospitals through credential mechanisms, maintaining the quality of the medical profession, as well as maintaining ethics and discipline in the medical profession.

Komite Medis memiliki peran strategis dalam mengendalikan kompetensi dan perilaku staf medis di rumah sakit. Selain itu, dalam rangka pelaksanaan audit medis, diperlukan ketentuan yang mengatur Komite Medis yang disesuaikan  dengan semangat profesionalisme sebagaimana diatur dalam peraturan perundang-undangan di bidang kesehatan dan rumah sakit.

Sesuai dengan Peraturan Menteri Kesehatan Republik Indonesia No. 755/Menkes/Per/IV/2011 tentang Penyelenggaraan Komite Medis  di  Rumah  Sakit,  maka  RS  Grha  Kedoya  menetapkan Komite Medis yang beranggotakan para dokter yang terbagi menjadi 3 subkomite, yaitu:

1. Subkomite Mutu Profesi: bertugas mempertahankan mutu dan profesionalisme seorang staf medis;
2. Subkomite Kredensial: bertugas menyaring profesionalisme staf medis dan memberikan rekomendasi rincian kewenangan klinis yang dapat dilakukan oleh seorang staf medis; dan
3. Subkomite  Etika  dan  Disiplin  Profesi:  bertugas  menjaga disiplin, etika, dan perilaku profesi staf medis.

## Tinjauan atas Efektivitas Sistem Pengendalian Internal

Kegiatan  subkomite  Komite  Medis  serta  tinjauan  efektivitas diuraikan sebagai berikut:

The Medical Committee plays a strategic role in controlling the competence and behavior of medical staff at the hospitals. In addition, with regard to medical audits, provisions governing the  Medical  Committee  are  necessary  in  line  with  the  spirit of professionalism in accordance with the prevailing laws and regulations in the healthcare and hospital sector.

In  accordance  with  the  Regulation  of  the  Minister  of  Health of  the  Republic  of  Indonesia  No.  755/Menkes/Per/IV/2011 on  the  Implementation  of  Medical  Committees  at  Hospitals, Grha Kedoya Hospital has established its Medical Committee consisting of doctors that is divided into 3 subcommittees, as follows:

1. Professional Quality Subcommittee: tasked with maintaining the quality and professionalism of medical staff;
2. Credential Subcommittee: tasked with screening the professionalism of medical staff and providing recommendations on details of clinical authority that can be exercised by medical staff; and
3. Ethics  and  Professional  Discipline  Subcommittee:  tasked with  maintaining  the  discipline,  ethics,  and  professional behavior of medical staff.

## Evaluation of Internal Control System's Effectiveness

The Medical Committee's subcommittees' activities and effectiveness review are as follows:

## Pernyataan Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi atas Kecukupan Sistem Pengendalian Internal

## Board of Commissioners' and Board of Directors' Statement on Internal Control System Implementation

Berdasarkan  hasil  evaluasi  tersebut,  Dewan  Komisaris  dan Direksi  berpendapat  bahwa  penerapan  sistem  pengendalian internal  di  tahun  2022  telah  cukup  baik.  Perseroan  berharap mutu pelayanan medis, profesionalisme, serta etika dari para dokter tetap terjaga, sehingga dapat memberikan pelayanan yang bermutu tinggi dan mengutamakan keselamatan pasien.

Based on the results of the evaluation, the Board of Commissioners  and  Board  of  Directors  hereby  declare  that internal  control  system  had  been  adequately  implemented in  2022.  Company  expects  the  quality  of  doctors'  medical services, professionalism, and ethics to be maintained in order to provide high quality services and prioritize patient safety in a consistent manner.

## Sistem Manajemen Risiko

## Risk Management System

Sistem  manajemen  risiko  adalah  proses  yang  proaktif  dan berkesinambungan, meliputi identifikasi, analisis, evaluasi, pengendalian, informasi komunikasi, pemantauan, dan pelaporan  risiko,  termasuk  berbagai  strategi  yang  dijalankan untuk mengelola risiko dan potensi. Pelaksanaan manajemen risiko  bertujuan  agar  proses  pembuatan  dan  pelaksanaan keputusan akan membantu  mencegah  konsekuensi yang merugikan  dan  meminimalkan  dampak  negatif  dari  kerugian yang disengaja pada suatu organisasi rumah sakit. Perseroan telah  mengembangkan  kolaborasi  antara  peran  manajemen risiko  dan quality  care dalam  organisasi  rumah  sakit,  uraian tugas, tanggung jawab, dan wewenang Komite Mutu Perseroan dengan tujuan memberikan perawatan yang aman dan berkualitas tinggi serta terus meminimalkan risiko.

Sebagai sebuah industri yang bergerak di bidang kesehatan, Perseroan  memiliki  karakteristik  padat  karya,  padat  modal, padat teknologi, dan padat regulasi. Dengan kondisi tersebut, Perseroan  senantiasa  menghadapi  risiko  terjadinya  kejadian yang  tidak  diharapkan,  baik  berupa  risiko  operasional  (klinis maupun non-klinis),  risiko  terkait  dengan  rencana  dan  tujuan strategis  rumah  sakit,  risiko  keuangan  terkait  dengan  proses bisnis  rumah  sakit,  dan  risiko  terkait  citra  rumah  sakit  yang dirasakan oleh masyarakat.

Guna terlaksananya program manajemen risiko yang proaktif bagi  mutu  dan  keselamatan  terkait  tata  laksana  dan  layanan dalam organisasi Perseroan, pelaksanaan manajemen risiko di tingkat rumah sakit dilakukan secara terpadu oleh Subkomite Manajemen  Risiko  Komite  Mutu  RS  Grha  Kedoya,  sesuai dengan Peraturan Menteri Kesehatan Republik Indonesia No. 80  Tahun  2020  tentang  Komite  Mutu  Rumah  Sakit.  Secara umum, pelaksanaan manajemen risiko dilakukan dengan:

System risk management is a proactive and continuous process that includes identification, analysis, evaluation, control, information  communication,  monitoring,  and  risk  reporting, as well as various strategies implemented to manage risks and potentials. The implementation of risk management is to ensure that  the  process  of  making  and  implementing  decisions  will help prevent adverse consequences and minimize the negative impacts of intentional harm on the hospitals' organization. The Company has developed an integrated risk management and quality care within the hospitals' organization, job descriptions, responsibilities, as well as the Company's Quality Committee's authorities with the aim of providing safe and high-quality care and continuously minimizing risk.

As a business entity that is engaged in the healthcare sector, the Company is labor-intensive, capital-intensive, technologyintensive, and regulation-intensive. Accordingly, the Company consistently  faces  the  risk  of  unexpected  events,  both  in  the form of operational risks (clinical and non-clinical), risks related to the hospitals' strategic plans and objectives, financial risks related to the hospitals' business processes, and risks related to the image of the hospitals in the eye of the general public.

In  order  to  implement  a  proactive  risk  management  program for  quality  and  safety  related  to  management  and  services within the Company's organization, the implementation of risk management  at  the  hospitals  is  carried  out  in  an  integrated manner by the Risk Management Subcommittee under the Grha Kedoya  Hospital's  Quality  Committee  in  accordance  with  the Regulation of the Minister of Health of the Republic of Indonesia No.  80/2020  on  Hospital  Quality  Committee.  In  general,  risk management is implemented through the following activities:

1. Mengumpulkan data;
2. Validasi data;
3. Analisis data;
4. Menerapkan perbaikan yang dapat dipertahankan; dan
5. Menentukan prioritas rumah sakit secara keseluruhan dan prioritas di tingkat unit pelayanan serta mengemas prioritasprioritas  tersebut  menjadi  suatu  program  peningkatan mutu secara keseluruhan yang terkoordinasi dengan baik.

Selain  itu,  penilaian  terhadap maturity  level dari  penerapan manajemen risiko pun sama pentingnya dengan proses penerapan  manajemen  risiko  itu  sendiri  karena  hal  tersebut dapat membantu organisasi rumah sakit dalam mengembangkan struktur manajemen risiko. Dalam proses penilaian risk maturity level , RS Grha Kedoya mengadopsi maturity model berdasarkan ISO 31000. Maturity model tersebut digunakan untuk menyediakan alat penilaian bagi organisasi untuk mendapatkan risk  management  maturity  level saat  ini  dan  menggunakan hasilnya untuk membuat rencana perbaikan yang akan memandu rumah sakit untuk mencapai target maturity level yang ideal.

Adapun  tahapan maturity  level manajemen  risiko  RS  Grha Kedoya diuraikan sebagai berikut:

1. Data gathering;
2. Data validation;
3. Data analysis;
4. Implementation of sustainable improvements; and
5. Determination of overall hospital priorities and priorities at the service unit level and integration of said priorities into a well-coordinated overall quality improvement program.

In addition, an  assessment  of  the  maturity  level of risk management  implementation  is  as  important  as  the  risk management  implementation  process  itself  as  it  can  assist hospital organizations in developing risk management structures.  To  assess  the  risk  maturity  level,  Grha  Kedoya Hospital  adopts  a  maturity  model  based  on  ISO  31000.  The maturity  model  is  used  to  provide  an  assessment  tool  for organizations to obtain the current risk management maturity level and use the results to create an improvement plan that will guide the hospitals to achieve the ideal maturity level target.

The stages of risk management maturity level at Grha Kedoya Hospital are as follows:

## Jenis dan Mitigasi Risiko

Berikut  jenis  dan  mitigasi  risiko  yang  dihadapi  Perseroan selama tahun 2022:

## Risk Type and Mitigation

The types and mitigation of risks faced by the Company during 2022 were as follows:

| Jenis Risiko  Type of Risk  Indikasi  Indication  Mitigasi  Mitigation  Risiko Utama yang Mempunyai Pengaruh Signifikan terhadap Kelangsungan Usaha Perseroan dan Entitas Anak  Main Risks with Significant Impacts on the Company's and Subsidiaries' Business Continuity  Risiko Permintaan Tenaga  Medis Khususnya Dokter dan  Spesialis  Risiko yang terjadi akibat permintaan tenaga medis,  khususnya  dokter  dan  spesialis  sangat  kompetitif  dan ketersediaannya terbatas.  •  Mempertahankan  tenaga  medis,  baik  dari  segi  kualitas  maupun  kuantitas  dengan  memastikan  lingkungan  kerja  yang kondusif dan menyenangkan;  •  Menunjang pertumbuhan individu tenaga medis; dan  •  Menawarkan kompensasi yang menarik sesuai kemampuan  finansial Perseroan.  Risk of Request for Medical  Personnel, Especially  Doctors and Specialists  Risk that occurs due to the very competitive demand  for  medical  personnel,  especially  doctors  and  specialists, as well as their limited availability.  •  Maintaining  medical  personnel,  both  in  terms  of  quality  and  quantity  by  ensuring  a  supportive  and  pleasant  working environment;  •  Supporting  the  growth  of  individual  medical  personnel;  and  •  Offering attractive compensation in line with the Company's  financial capacity.  ## Risiko Usaha yang Bersifat Material, baik Secara Langsung maupun Tidak Langsung yang dapat Memengaruhi Hasil Usaha dan Kondisi Keuangan Perseroan dan Entitas Anak  Material Business Risks that Can Directly or Indirectly Affect the Company's and Subsidiaries' Operating Results and Financial Condition  Risiko Tindakan Medis  Medical Action Risk  Risiko  yang  terjadi  dalam  setiap  rangkaian  proses  pengobatan, seperti penegakan diagnosis, operasi,  penentuan  obat  dan  dosisnya,  pasca-operasi,  dan  lain sebagainya.  Risk that occurs in every treatment processes, such  as  diagnosis,  surgery,  determination  of  drugs  and  their doses, post-operation, and so on.  •  Menjaga  mutu  pelayanan  kesehatan  memiliki  prosedur  standar yang harus dijalankan di setiap rumah sakit yang  dimiliki;  •  Melaksanakan  pelatihan  terpadu  yang  akan  mencetak  tenaga terampil dalam bidang layanan kesehatan; dan  •  Memantau seluruh aktivitas yang dilakukan melalui Dewan  Pengawas untuk menjaga konsistensi dan mutu pelayanan  kesehatan yang disediakan.  •  Maintaining  the  quality  and  standards  of  healthcare  services at all of the Company's hospitals;  •  Implementing integrated training that will produce skilled  workers in the field of healthcare services; and  •  Monitoring all activities carried out through the Supervisory  Board  to  maintain  consistency  and  quality  of  healthcare  services provided.  Risiko Perubahan Teknologi  Technology Change Risk  Perkembangan teknologi perawatan kesehatan yang  pesat menyebabkan keusangan pada peralatan dan  fasilitas  medis  yang  ada,  karena  standar  peralatan  yang lama dapat tertinggal jauh dari peralatan baru  yang lebih canggih.  The  rapid  development  of  healthcare  technology  causes obsolescence of existing medical equipment  and facilities,  as  the  old  equipment  standards  can  lag far behind new, more sophisticated equipment.  •  Mengikuti perkembangan dan memperbarui peralatan dan  fasilitas yang dimiliki;  •  Melatih  tenaga  medis  untuk  mengoperasikan  peralatan  terbaru; dan  •  Melakukan  transformasi  bisnis  dan  layanan  yang  berbasis  digital  karena  dapat  mempermudah  dalam  proses  pengumpulan  dan  pengolahan  informasi  (data),  komunikasi,  pelaporan  informasi  dan  monitoring  kepada  manajemen.  •  Keeping  abreast  developments  and  update  equipment  and facilities owned;  •  Training  medical  personnel  to  operate  the  latest  equipment; and  •  Conducting  digital-based  business  and  services  transformation  to  simplify  the  data  collecting  and  processing process, communication, reporting information  and monitoring to the management.  Risiko Kepercayaan Publik  pada Sistem dan Infrastruktur  Kesehatan Lokal  Risk of Public Trust in  Local Health Systems and  Infrastructure  Adanya  kecenderungan  masyarakat  Indonesia,  khususnya  kelas  menengah  ke  atas  yang  kurang  percaya  pada  layanan  kesehatan  lokal  dan  lebih  memilih untuk berobat ke luar negeri.  Indonesian  people's  tendency  to  have  less  confidence in local health services and prefer to seek  treatment abroad, especially the upper middle class.  Melakukan  penguatan  pelayanan  kesehatan,  baik  dari  segi  fasilitas  pelayanan  kesehatan  (infrastruktur)  maupun  segi  sumber daya manusia kesehatan.  Enhancing  healthcare  services,  both  in  terms  of  healthcare  services  infrastructure  and  in  terms  of  healthcare  human  resources.   |

Risiko Investasi atau Aksi  Korporasi  Investment Risk or Corporate  Action  Ekspansi  bisnis  dan  investasi  belanja  modal  untuk  pengembangan Perseroan dan Entitas Anak.  Business  expansion  and  capital  expenditure  investment  for  the  development  of  the  Company  and Subsidiaries.  Memperhitungkan  dan  menganalisa  setiap  risiko  dan  kemungkinan  yang  mungkin  akan  dialami  dalam  setiap  investasi atau aksi korporasi yang akan dilakukan.  Considering and analyzing every risk and possibility in every  investment or corporate action that will be carried out by the  Company.  Risiko Bahan Baku  Raw Material Risk  Persediaan  obat-obatan  tertentu  dikontrol  secara  ketat  dan  hanya  dapat  diperoleh  dengan  rantai  pasokan tertentu dan pembayarannya hanya dapat  dilakukan secara kas.  The supply of certain medicines is strictly controlled  and can only be obtained by certain supply chains  and the payment can only be made in cash.  Memiliki  hubungan  baik  dengan  pemasok  dan  memiliki  beragam pemasok untuk memenuhi kebutuhan Perseroan.  Maintaining good relationships with suppliers and having a  variety of suppliers to meet the needs of the Company.   |

## Risiko Umum General Risks

| Risiko Kondisi Perekonomian  secara Makro  Macroeconomic Condition  Risk  Kondisi perekonomian yang cenderung berfluktuatif  dari  tahun  ke  tahun  dapat  berdampak  pada  pertumbuhan  permintaan  dan  penawaran  akan  barang dan jasa.  Economic conditions that tend to fluctuate from year  to year can have adverse impacts on demand and  supply growth for goods and services.  Memperhatikan  kondisi  perekonomian  secara  makro  dan  global, serta melakukan langkah penyesuaian sesuai dengan  kondisi perekonomian yang terjadi.  Observing  macro  and  global  economic  conditions,  as  well  as making adjustments in accordance with current economic  conditions.  Risiko Fluktuasi Nilai Tukar  Rupiah terhadap Mata Uang  Asing  Risk of Fluctuations in Rupiah  Exchange Rates against  Foreign Currencies  Risiko yang muncul akibat fluktuasi nilai tukar Rupiah  terhadap mata uang asing karena harga beberapa  peralatan mengacu pada mata uang asing.  The  risk  that  arises  due  to  fluctuations  in  the  exchange  rate  of  the  Rupiah  against  foreign  currencies as the prices of some equipment refer to  foreign currencies.  Memperhatikan  perubahan  nilai  tukar  dan  melakukan  langkah  yang  dianggap  perlu  apabila  perubahannya  dapat  mengganggu kegiatan operasional Perseroan.  Paying  attention  to  changes  in  exchange  rates  and  taking  necessary  measures  if  the  changes  were  to  disrupt  the  Company's operations.   |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|

| Jenis Risiko  Type of Risk  Indikasi  Indication  Mitigasi  Mitigation  Risiko Perubahan Kebijakan  Pemerintah  Risk of Changes in  Government Policy  Perubahan  kebijakan  pemerintah  yang  tidak  diantisipasi  dan  memiliki  dampak  yang  kurang  menguntungkan  bagi  Perseroan,  maka  hal  tersebut dapat memengaruhi kegiatan operasional  perusahaan  yang  pada  akhirnya  memengaruhi  pendapatan perusahaan.  Changes  in  government  policies  that  are  not  anticipated  and  have  adverse  impacts  on  the  company, disrupting the company's operations that  in turn will affect the company's revenues.  Mematuhi  kebijakan  pemerintah  dengan  cara  selalu  menyesuaikan  rencana  kerja  dan  prospek  bisnis  yang  tidak  bertentangan terhadap perubahan peraturan kebijakan yang  dikeluarkan oleh pemerintah.  Complying with government policies by persistently adjusting  work  plans  and  business  prospects  that  are  in  line  with  changes in the government's policies and regulations.  ## Risiko bagi Investor  Investors' Risks  Risiko Kondisi Pasar Modal  Indonesia  Indonesian Capital Market  Condition Risk  Kondisi pasar modal Indonesia yang memengaruhi  harga dan likuiditas saham Perseroan.  Indonesian capital market conditions that affect the  price and liquidity of the Company's shares.  Mencatatkan saham di Bursa Efek Indonesia, tidak ada jaminan  bahwa pasar untuk saham Perseroan yang diperdagangkan  tersebut akan aktif atau likuid karena pasar modal Indonesia  kemungkinan relative kurang likuid, memiliki volatilitas yang  lebih tinggi, harga-harga di pasar modal Indonesia juga relatif  tidak stabil dibandingkan dengan pasar modal lainnya.  Listing shares on the Indonesia Stock Exchange, there is no  guarantee that the market for the Company's shares traded  will be active or liquid because the Indonesian capital market  is likely to be relatively less liquid, has higher volatility, prices  in the Indonesian capital market are also relatively unstable  compared to other capital markets.  Risiko Harga Penawaran  Bid Price Risk  Harga  penawaran  atas  saham  yang  ditawarkan  Perseroan  mungkin  tidak  dapat  mengindikasikan  harga  saham  Perseroan  yang  akan  berlaku  di  pasar perdagangan saham, dan harga saham yang  ditawarkan Perseroan dapat berfluktuasi.  The  offering  price  of  the  Company's  shares  may  not be able to indicate the price of the Company's  shares  that  will  apply  in  the  stock  trading  market,  and the price of the Company's shares may fluctuate.  Setelah penawaran umum perdana saham Perseroan, harga  saham akan sepenuhnya ditentukan oleh tingkat penawaran  dan permintaan investor di Bursa Efek Indonesia. Perseroan  tidak  dapat  memprediksi  tingkat  fluktuasi  harga  saham  Perseroan setelah penawaran umum perdana.  After  the  initial  public  offering,  the  Company's  share  price  will be fully determined by the level of supply and demand  among  investors  on  the  Indonesia  Stock  Exchange.  The  Company cannot predict the level of fluctuation of its share  price after the initial public offering.   |
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|

## Tinjauan atas Efektivitas Sistem Manajemen Risiko

Berdasarkan hasil penilaian risk maturity level , RS Grha Kedoya telah  mencapai  target maturity manajemen  risiko  pada  level 3 di tahun 2022. Namun demikian, upaya berkesinambungan tetap diperlukan untuk mempertahankan  perbaikan yang telah dicapai serta melakukan upaya-upaya untuk dapat meningkatkan  level risk  maturity  level ke  tahap  yang  lebih tinggi  demi  tercapainya  pelayanan  yang  bermutu  tinggi  dan mengutamakan  keselamatan  pasien,  staf,  fasililitas, bisnis, reputasi, dan lingkungan.

## Pernyataan Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi atas Kecukupan Sistem Manajemen Risiko

Pada tahun 2022, Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi menilai bahwa penerapan  sistem  manajemen  risiko  telah  berjalan  efektif, meskipun banyak tantangan yang dihadapi Perseroan terutama dengan adanya pandemi Covid-19 yang mengakibatkan munculnya  ketakutan  dari  tenaga  medis  dan  pasien  untuk datang ke rumah sakit.

## Evaluation of Risk Management System's Effectiveness

Based on the results of the risk maturity level assessment, Grha Kedoya Hospital had achieved the risk management maturity target at level 3 in 2022. However, continuous efforts are still needed to maintain the improvements that have been achieved as  well  as  efforts  to  increase  the  risk  maturity  level  higher  in order to achieve high quality services and sustainably maintain efforts to prioritize the  safety  of  patients,  staff, facilities, business, reputation, and the environment.

## Board of Commissioners' and Board of Directors' Statement on Risk Management System Adequacy

The  Board  of  Commissioners  and  the  Board  of  Directors conclude that the risk management system had been implemented effectively in 2022 despite numerous challenges faced by the Company, especially as the Covid-19 pandemic incited fear among medical personnel and patients to come to the hospital.

## Kode Etik

Code of Conduct

Perseroan telah memiliki Kode Etik (Pedoman Etik dan Hukum) yang menjadi panduan berperilaku bagi seluruh insan Perseroan dalam melaksanakan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya.

## Pokok-Pokok Kode Etik

Kode Etik merupakan landasan bagi seluruh insan Perseroan dalam berperilaku, terkait dengan kegiatan usaha di lingkungan Perseroan.  Kode  Etik  mengatur  berbagai  hak  dan  kewajiban pihak  Perseroan  dan  karyawan  untuk  menjaga  hubungan yang  baik  dan  harmonis  antara  Perseroan  dan  pemangku kepentingan,  serta  menjaga  keberlanjutan  usaha  Perseroan. Pokok-pokok Kode Etik Perseroan meliputi:

1. Ketentuan umum;
2. Kode Etik yang berlaku di RS Grha Kedoya;
3. Pelaporan  dan  penanganan  dugaan  pelanggaran  Kode Etik; dan
4. Monitoring dan evaluasi.

## Pihak yang Terkait dalam Kode Etik

Kode  Etik  berlaku  bagi  seluruh  pihak  yang  terkait  dengan Perseroan,  seperti  Dewan  Komisaris,  Direksi,  dan  karyawan Perseroan.

## Bentuk Sosialisasi Kode Etik

Pelaksanaan  sosialisasi  dan  internalisasi  Kode  Etik  dilakukan secara berkesinambungan guna menjangkau Dewan Komisaris, Direksi, dan karyawan. Kode Etik juga tertulis dalam kontrak kerja perekrutan karyawan yang harus dipahami dan ditandatangani oleh  seluruh  karyawan.  Seluruh  karyawan  diharapkan  untuk berperilaku sesuai Kode Etik dalam kegiatan sehari-hari.

## Sanksi atas Pelanggaran Kode Etik

Perseroan akan memberikan sanksi kepada setiap insan Perseroan  yang  terbukti  melakukan  pelanggaran  terhadap Kode  Etik.  Sanksi  yang  diberikan  pada  pelanggar  Kode  Etik dilakukan sesuai kebijakan dan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku, yaitu:

1. Pemberian sanksi atas pelanggaran Kode Etik yang dilakukan oleh karyawan diberikan oleh Direksi atau Pejabat yang berwenang sesuai ketentuan yang berlaku; dan

The  Company  already  has  Code  of  Conduct  (Ethical  and Legal  Guideline)  that  serves  as  a  behavioral  guideline  for  all employees in performing their duties and responsibilities.

## Code of Conduct Principles

The Code of Conduct is the behavioral guideline for all employees in conducting business activities within the Company. The Code of Conduct regulates the various rights and obligations of the Company and employees to maintain a good and harmonious relationship between the Company and stakeholders, as well as maintaining  the  sustainability  of  the  Company's  business.  The Company's Code of Conduct principles includes the following:

1. General provisions;
2. Code of Conduct applicable at Grha Kedoya Hospital;
3. Alleged Code of Conduct violations reporting and handling; and
4. Monitoring and evaluation.

## Stakeholders in Code of Conduct

The  Code  of  Conduct  applies  to  all  stakeholders  of  the Company, such as the Board of Commissioners, the Board of Directors, and all employees.

## Code of Conduct Dissemination Efforts

The Code of Conduct is disseminated and internalized on an ongoing basis in order to reach the Board of Commissioners, the Board of Directors, and employees. The Code of Conduct is also written in the employment contract during recruitment that must be understood and signed by all employees. In addition, all employees are expected to behave in accordance with the Code of Conduct in their daily activities.

## Sanctions for Code of Conduct Violations

The  Company  will  impose  sanctions  on  every  employee who  is  proven  to  have  violated  the  Code  of  Conduct.  The aforementioned  sanctions  are  imposed  in  accordance  with applicable policies and laws and regulations, as follows:

1. Sanctions  for  Code  of  Conduct  violations  committed by  employees  are  imposed  by  the  Board  of  Directors or authorized officials in accordance with applicable regulations; and

Tata Kelola Perusahaan Corporate Governance

2. Peringatan tertulis secara bertahap maupun sanksi pemutusan  hubungan  kerja  menjadi  wewenang  Direksi dengan  menimbang  berat  ringannya  pelanggaran  yang dibuat.
2. Gradual written warnings as well as termination of employment  fall  under  the  authority  of  the  Board  of Directors  by  considering  the  severity  of  the  violations committed.

## Upaya Penegakan Kode Etik

Upaya  penegakkan  Kode  Etik  dilakukan  dengan  memantau setiap tindakan-tindakan yang melanggar Kode Etik . Penegakkan Kode Etik  ini dilakukan dengan melibatkan seluruh insan  Perseroan  untuk  melaporkan  indikasi  pelanggaran  ke Departemen Pengembangan Sumber Daya Manusia.

## Sistem Pelaporan Pelanggaran

## Whistleblowing System

Sistem  pelaporan  pelanggaran  ( whistleblowing  system /WBS) merupakan bagian dari pelaksanaan Perseroan untuk konsisten menjalankan pengendalian terhadap tindakan fraud /kecurangan, pelanggaran  hukum  dan  peraturan,  etika  perilaku  bisnis  serta pelanggaran  lainnya.  Kebijakan  WBS  di  Perseroan  dikenal dengan 'Budaya Rasa Aman Komite Mutu'. Penerapan sistem ini diharapkan dapat membantu Perseroan dalam memberantas segala  pelanggaran ataupun potensi pelanggaran yang dapat merusak reputasi Perseroan atau karyawan tertentu.

## Cara Penyampaian dan Pihak yang Mengelola Pengaduan

Setiap pelanggaran yang terjadi  dapat dilaporkan melalui:

The  whistleblowing  system  (WBS)  is  part  of  the  Company's commitment to consistently mitigating frauds, violations of laws and regulations as well as ethical business conduct, in addition to other violations. At the Company, the WBS policy is known as the 'Quality Committee Safety Culture'. The WBS system is expected to assist the Company in eradicating all violations or potential violations that can damage its reputation or harm certain employees.

## Kebijakan Anti Korupsi dan Gratifikasi

Anti Corruption and Gratification Policy

Perseroan berupaya untuk menciptakan keberlangsungan usaha yang sehat dan terbebas dari tindak kecurangan seperti korupsi, kolusi, dan nepotisme (KKN), termasuk suap. Perilaku kecurangan  tersebut  dapat  mengakibatkan  kerugian  secara finansial  maupun  non-finansial,  merusak  citra  baik,  ataupun menghilangkan  kepercayaan  pemangku  kepentingan  kepada Perseroan. Untuk menghindari terjadinya perilaku kecurangan tersebut, Perseroan berpedoman pada Peraturan Perusahaan.

## Memberi dan Menerima Suap

Perseroan  melarang  insan  Perseroan  untuk  memberi  dan/atau menerima suap yang dapat mempengaruhi pengambilan keputusan dan melanggar ketentuan yang berlaku dengan ketentuan:

1. Perseroan tidak akan meminta atau menerima atau memberikan manfaat apapun yang dapat dianggap sebagai suap dari mitra usaha, pemasok, penasihat, konsultan, auditor atau pihak yang berhubungan;
2. Perseroan  dilarang  menawarkan  manfaat  kepada  pejabat pemerintah,  pasien,  serikat  pekerja,  atau  pihak  eksternal lainnya dalam upaya membujuk mereka melakukan suatu tindakan penipuan; dan
3. Perseroan tidak akan menerima tawaran atau pembayaran yang bersifat suap, kecurangan, pemberian hadiah untuk  memenangkan  atau  mempertahankan  bisnis  atau memengaruhi keputusan bisnis apapun.

The Company strives to create healthy business continuity free from acts of fraud such as corruption, collusion and nepotism (KKN), including bribery. Such fraudulent behaviors can result in financial and non-financial losses, tarnish the Company's good reputation,  or  diminish  stakeholders'  trust  in  the  Company. To prevent such fraudulent behaviors, the Company refers to Corporate Regulations.

## Bribing and Receiving Bribes

The  Company  prohibits  all  employees  from  bribing  and/or receiving bribes that may influence decision making and violate applicable provisions, as follows:

1. The  Company  will  not  ask  for  or  accept  or  provide  any benefits  that  can  be  considered  as  bribes  from  business partners, suppliers, advisors, consultants, auditors or stakeholders;
2. The  Company  is  prohibited  from  offering  benefits  to government  officials,  customers,  trade  unions,  or  other external  stakeholders  in  an  effort  to  persuade  them  to commit fraudulent acts; and
3. The Company will not accept offers or payments that are classified as bribery, fraudulent, or gratuity to win or retain business or influence any business decisions.

## Hadiah, Tanda Balas Jasa, dan Jamuan

Perseroan melarang insan Perseroan untuk menerima dan/atau memberi hadiah, cendera mata, jamuan bisnis ataupun fasilitas lainnya,  yang  dapat  mempengaruhi  pengambilan  keputusan dan melanggar ketentuan yang berlaku dengan ketentuan:

1. Perseroan  menjalankan  bisnis  dengan  integritas.  Perseroan tidak menerima atau memberikan hadiah atau tanda balas jasa atau jamuan berlebihan dari atau kepada pihak manapun; dan
2. Hadiah yang diberikan atau diterima pada hari raya keagamaan tidak termasuk asalkan hadiah tersebut masih bernilai pantas dan tidak terkait dengan komitmen bisnis apapun.

## Sosialisasi Kebijakan Anti Korupsi dan Gratifikasi

Sosialisasi kebijakan  anti korupsi  dan  gratifikasi  dilakukan oleh  Perseroan  dengan  adanya  keterlibatan  seluruh  insan perusahaan.  Pada  tahun  2022,  sosialisasi  kebijakan  tersebut dilakukan pada  saat orientasi  karyawan  baru  dan  dalam refreshment pada  karyawan  lama  serta  mengikuti  webinar yang diselenggarakan oleh PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk dan  Komisi  Pemberantasan  Korupsi  terkait  Good  Corporate Governance: Anti Bribery Fundamentals .

## Laporan Anti Korupsi dan Gratifikasi

Hingga akhir tahun 2022, tidak terdapat laporan yang masuk atas  tindak  pidana  korupsi  maupun  gratifikasi  yang  memiliki kaitan dengan Perseroan ataupun insan Perseroan.

## Gratuities, Kickbacks, and Meals

The Company prohibits all employees from receiving and/or giving  gratuities,  kickbacks,  business  entertainment  or  other facilities,  which  may  influence  decision  making  and  violate applicable provisions, as follows:

1. The Company  conducts business with integrity. The Company does not accept or give gratuities or kickbacks or excessive entertainment from or to any party; and
2. Gratuities given or received on religious holidays are not included as long as they are still of reasonable value and not related to any business commitments.

## Anti Corruption and Gratification Policy Dissemination

The  Company  disseminates  anti-corruption  and  gratification policies by involving all employees. In 2022, the dissemination of  this  policy  was  carried  out  during  orientation  for  new employees and during refreshment course for old employees as well as in a webinar organized by PT Elang Mahkota Teknologi Tbk  and  the  Corruption  Eradication  Commission  on  Good Corporate Governance: Anti Bribery Fundamentals.

## Anti Corruption and Gratification Report

As of end of 2022, there were no reports of criminal acts of corruption or gratuity related to the Company or the Company's employees.
